 Order
08.05.2024 Order No.
This matter is taken up by video conferencing mode.
This interlocutory application has been filed by the petitioner for modification of the order dated 23.04.2024.

3. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
4.

Considering the averments made in the application and after hearing learned counsel for the parties, the order dated 23.04.2024 passed in W.P.(C) No. 16806 of 2019 is recalled and fresh order is passed in W.P.(C) No. 16806 of 2019 in separate order sheet.
5. Accordingly, the I.A. stands disposed of.
(DR. B.R. SARANGI) JUDGE (G. SATAPATHY) JUDGE P.T.O.
Order No.
This matter is taken up by hybrid mode.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
3. The petitioner has filed this writ petition with the following prayer:
"Therefore it is prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to admit the writ petition and issue rule NISI to the Opp.parties to show cause as to why.

i) The compensation amount determined by the land acquisition Officer for the area Gokulananda Naik vs State Of Orissa And Others ..... ... on 8 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64802461/
1 AC2.02 dec. which has been acquired way back in the year 1954-55 and the estimate of compensation amount being approved by the Collector under Annexure-7, shall not be paid to the petitioner immediately.
ii) The letter of the Govt. dated 07.08.2019 under Annexure-11 shall not be quashed as the same was floated dehorse the provision of the Act, 2013 and is contumacious to the order passed in W.P.(C) No.3671/2002 and CONTC No.939/17.
iii) to pass any such other order/s direction/s under the circumstances of the case."
4.

entities.text: Gokulananda Naik vs State Of Orissa And Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In course of hearing, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner states that the case of the petitioner for determination of compensation for the remaining area of Ac.2.02 for payment of compensation has already been recommended by the Land Acquisition Officer, Sundargarh to the Executive Engineer, Minor Irrigation Division, Sundargarh on 09.08.2018 under Annexure-7, and,
therefore, direction may be given to the authority to take a decision on the same taking into consideration the calculation sheet under Annexure-6, and pass appropriate order in accordance with law within a stipulated time, to which learned State Counsel has raised no objection.
5.

As agreed by learned counsel for the parties and after going through the records, this Court,
without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, disposes of the Writ Petition directing the authority to take a decision on the recommendation made by the Land Acquisition Officer,
Sundargarh to the Executive Engineer, Minor Irrigation Division, Sundargarh on 09.08.2018 under Annexure-7 and pass appropriate order taking into consideration the calculation sheet under Annexure-6, as early as possible, preferably within a period of three months from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
(DR. B.R. SARANGI) JUDGE (G. SATAPATHY) Ashok JUDGE Signed by: ASHOK KUMAR JAGADEB MOHAPATRA
